structured.reason: The mutant validates against a copy of the schema with "$defs"/"definitions" removed, so a valid object schema that uses "$ref" into its definitions can no longer be enforced. Router-side validation then either ignores those nested constraints or fails to resolve the reference on valid output, which breaks the declared Draft 2020-12 semantics.
sources: Mapping schema inputs shall be valid object JSON Schemas and router-side validation shall enforce their declared Draft 2020-12 semantics after provider execution.
A valid object JSON Schema mapping is preserved and router-side validation enforces its declared nested/common constraints rather than silently ignoring them.
structured.test_focus: Normalize a mapping schema whose property uses "$ref": "#/$defs/Item" with a constrained Item. Check that the parser accepts a conforming nested value and rejects a value that breaks the Item constraint with a validation error, not a ref-resolution error.
